landmarks.name: Arrakeen
landmarks.subtitle: Imperial Seat & Citadel
landmarks.summary: The administrative capital city, sheltered behind the natural granite barrier of the Shield Wall.
landmarks.lore: Built to withstand severe heat and dust storms, Arrakeen contains the Residency and primary spice distribution hubs.

gallery.caption: Residency District overlooking the Shield Wall

landmarks.name: Sietch Tabr
landmarks.subtitle: Fremen Deep Desert Stronghold
landmarks.summary: Subterranean Fremen cavern settlement hidden beneath the rocky ridges of the Minor Erg.
landmarks.lore: Governed by Naib Stilgar, Sietch Tabr stores millions of decaliters of water in sealed underground catch-basins.
